verdict.rationale: Stripe's Disputes API explicitly supports retrieving disputes, uploading evidence, and submitting responses programmatically, and webhooks can notify agents of new disputes, plus an official MCP server lets agents interact with the Stripe API — together these enable an agent-driven end-to-end dispute workflow. missing for 10: no first-party documentation or example showing an agent autonomously assembling/curating evidence content (vs. just uploading it), no end-to-end walkthrough or hands-on/independent verification of an agent completing a dispute unattended, and no confirmation that MCP tools specifically cover dispute evidence submission.
